cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is CCA 432, you are performing a flight from Guangzhou to Beijing, you are maintaining 5400 meters, over IKUBA, squawking 5655, make initial contact with Beijing Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 你的呼号是 CCA 432，执行 Guangzhou 到 Beijing 航班，保持 5400 米，过 IKUBA，应答机 5655，与 北京进近 建立初始联系。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, CCA 432, maintaining 5400 meters, over IKUBA, squawking 5655.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，CCA 432，保持 5400 米，过 IKUBA，应答机 5655。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 432, Beijing Approach, radar contact, climb to and maintain 6600 meters, contact Beijing Control on 118.2.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 432，北京进近，雷达识别，爬升并保持 6600 米，联系北京管制118.2。
cards.referenceText: Climb to and maintain 6600 meters, 118.2, CCA 432.

cards.audioText: B: Now you are maintaining 6600 meters, contact Beijing Control and request further climb.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你保持 6600 米，联系北京管制并请求继续爬升。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CCA 432, maintaining 6600 meters, requests further climb.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，CCA 432，保持 6600 米，请求继续爬升。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 432, negative due traffic, maintain 6600 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 432，因交通原因不批准，保持 6600 米。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 432, climb to and maintain 8900 meters, turn left heading 210, fly direct to OBLIK.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 432，爬升并保持 8900 米，左转航向 210，直飞 OBLIK。
cards.referenceText: Climb to and maintain 8900 meters, turn left heading 210, fly direct to OBLIK, CCA 432.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升并保持 8900 米，左转航向 210，直飞 OBLIK，CCA 432。

cards.audioText: B: During cruise, your weather radar observed a thunderstorm ahead, request turn right and state the reason.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 巡航期间，你的气象雷达发现前方有雷暴，请求右转并说明原因。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CCA 432, our weather radar observed a thunderstorm ahead, request turn right.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，CCA 432，我们的气象雷达发现前方有雷暴，请求右转。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 432, negative due military activity, continue present heading for 20 miles.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 432，因军事活动不批准，继续当前航向 20 海里。
cards.referenceText: Roger, continue present heading for 20 miles, CCA 432.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，继续当前航向 20 海里，CCA 432。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are clear of whether, report it to Beijing Control and request resume flight route.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你已脱离天气，向北京管制报告并请求恢复航路。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CCA 432, clear of whether, request resume flight route.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，CCA 432，已脱离天气，请求恢复航路。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 432, turn left heading 240 to rejoin Amber 461, climb and maintain 10100 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 432，左转航向 240 重新加入 Amber 461，爬升并保持 10100 米。
cards.referenceText: Turn left heading 240 to rejoin A461, climb and maintain 10100 meters, CCA 432.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向 240 重新加入 A461，爬升并保持 10100 米，CCA 432。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 432, maintain 10100 meters, offset 10 miles left to avoid the reported strong downdraft.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 432，保持 10100 米，向左偏置 10 海里，以避让报告的强下沉气流。
cards.referenceText: Maintain 10100 meters, offset 10 miles left to avoid the reported strong downdraft, CCA 432.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持 10100 米，向左偏置 10 海里，以避让报告的强下沉气流，CCA 432。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are flying into a small cumulonimbus, contact Beijing Control and tell the controller you'd like to hold at PEK VOR for weather improvement.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你正飞入一小块积雨云，联系北京管制，告诉管制员你想在 PEK VOR 等待，等待天气好转。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, CCA 432, we are flying into a small cumulonimbus, request hold at PEK VOR for weather improvement.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，CCA 432，我们正飞入一小块积雨云，请求在 PEK VOR 等待，等待天气好转。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 432, hold at PEK VOR as published, when clear of weather, contact Beijing Approach on 119.25.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 432，按公布程序在 PEK VOR 等待，天气解除后联系北京进近119.25。
cards.referenceText: Hold at PEK VOR as published, when clear of weather, contact Beijing Approach on 119.25, CCA 432.
cards.referenceTextZh: 按公布程序在 PEK VOR 等待，天气解除后联系北京进近119.25，CCA 432。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are approaching RENOB, maintaining 4800 meters, you have got information L, contact Beijing Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: B: 现在你接近 RENOB，保持 4800 米，已收到信息 L，联系北京进近。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, CCA 432, approaching RENOB, maintaining 4800 meters, information L.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，CCA 432，接近 RENOB，保持 4800 米，信息 L。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 432, Beijing Approach, radar contact, descend to and maintain 2400 meters, RENOB-2B arrival, expect ILS approach Runway 01.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 432，北京进近，雷达识别，下降并保持 2400 米，RENOB-2B 进场，预计跑道 01 ILS 进近。
cards.referenceText: Descend to and maintain 2400 meters, RENOB-2B arrival, expect ILS approach Runway 01, CCA 432.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降并保持 2400 米，RENOB-2B 进场，预计跑道 01 ILS 进近，CCA 432。

cards.audioText: C: CCA 432, turn right heading 330, descend to 900 meters, cleared ILS approach Runway 01, report established.
cards.audioTextZh: C: CCA 432，右转航向 330，下降到 900 米，可以跑道 01 ILS 进近，建立后报告。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 330, descend to 900 meters, cleared ILS approach Runway 01, report established, CCA 432.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 330，下降到 900 米，可以跑道 01 ILS 进近，建立后报告，CCA 432。
